description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. You can create and query it in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 应用名称，仅支持传单个名称。
description.en: Application name. Only a single name is supported.

title.en: Modify the name of a specified application

descriptions.zh:
#### 使用说明
本接口用于修改指定应用的名称。
#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为200次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
#### How-To  
This API is used to modify the name of a specified application.  
#### queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 200 requests per minute per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Invoke the API appropriately.
